items: GOMBE STATE (PSI 9.5): SEC Approves 97km Roads Worth Over ₦113Bn, 40 CNG Emergency/Water Vehicles, 2027–2029 MTEF & Kolmani Oil Readiness
DELTA STATE (PSI 9.3): Gov. Oborevwori Presents ₦1.23Tn 2027 Budget, Cuts Debt from ₦463Bn to ₦63Bn & Approves Allowances for 3,537 Health Workers
LAGOS STATE (PSI 9.1): Gifts ₦300M & iPhone 18 Pro Max to FIFA U-17 Champions Flamingos, Hosts Floyd Mayweather, Honours 986 Civil Servants & Issues Detty December Scam Alert
OYO STATE (PSI 8.9): Unveils ₦1.115Tn 2027 Budget (60.1% Capital), Starts Circular Road Segment 2 Verification & Condemns Attack on Rule of Law Team
KANO STATE (PSI 8.7): Gov. Yusuf Injects ₦5Bn in 7th Pension Payment Round, Clearing ₦37Bn of ₦40Bn Inherited Backlog
KADUNA STATE (PSI 8.5): Gov. Uba Sani Completes Ultramodern Kakuri (Southern) Bus Terminal Project
EDO STATE (PSI 8.3): Gov. Okpebholo Named Silverbird Man of the Year for Anti-Cultism & Kidnapping Gains; EDOHERMA Licenses Diaspora JEMA Hospitals
CROSS RIVER STATE (PSI 8.1): Reopens Renovated Calabar Int'l Convention Centre for Global MICE Economy & Assesses Calabar South Fire Losses
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 7.9): Completes Mararaban Garta–Kamale Road with 4-Cell Bridge & Inspects Dougire Primary School for Flood Mitigation
IMO STATE (PSI 7.8): Gov. Uzodimma Facilitates Maiden International Commercial Flight Lifting at Upgraded Sam Mbakwe Cargo Airport
ENUGU STATE (PSI 7.6): Completes Comprehensive Redevelopment of Government Technical College (GTC) Enugu
NASARAWA STATE (PSI 7.4): First Lady Launches ₦50,000 Women Empowerment Grants in Akwanga; Gov. Sule Welcomes New CP Sheikh Danko
FCT ABUJA (PSI 7.2): FCTA Clarifies UNIABUJA Land Rationalisation to 4,519.80 Hectares Based on 2016 Joint Committee Report
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 7.0): Partners UNICEF to Host Youth Behavioural Change Summit on Child Rights, Health, Nutrition & WASH
OSUN STATE (PSI 6.6): Debunks Fake News on Ruler Demotion, Clarifying Ataoja-in-Council Discipline of Two Baales Over Land Grabbing

GOMBE (PSI 9.5): Gov. Muhammadu Inuwa Yahaya's SEC approved 7 road contracts spanning 97km across 4 LGAs, ₦3.8bn for 20 CNG firefighting trucks and 20 water tankers, the 2027–2029 MTEF, an updated 2027–2030 Social Protection Policy, and reviewed preparations ahead of December 2026 Kolmani oil drilling resumption.

DELTA (PSI 9.3): Gov. Sheriff Oborevwori presented a ₦1.23 trillion 2027 Budget (65% capital, 35% recurrent), disclosed cutting state debt from ₦463bn to ₦63bn with ₦283bn projected 2026 IGR, approved federal-aligned salary tables for doctors plus uniform allowances for 3,537 health workers, and received the Unity Adeda inquiry report.

LAGOS (PSI 9.1): Gov. Babajide Sanwo-Olu gifted ₦300m and iPhone 18 Pro Max devices to the victorious Flamingos, hosted boxing champion Floyd Mayweather Jr. on youth sports partnerships, honoured 986 long-serving public servants, launched school child-safeguarding training, and issued LASCOPA anti-scam warnings for Detty December visitors.

OYO (PSI 8.9): Oyo presented its ₦1.115 trillion 2027 Budget breakdown (₦670.03bn capital, ₦618.72bn Jan–Sep 2026 revenue), commenced property owner verification for Segment II of the Ibadan Circular Road, and condemned armed herder attacks on OYRLEA enforcement officers in Kajola LGA.

KANO (PSI 8.7): Gov. Abba Kabir Yusuf flagged off the seventh tranche of retirement benefit disbursements with a fresh ₦5 billion injection, bringing total pension arrears paid to ₦37 billion out of over ₦40 billion inherited.

KADUNA (PSI 8.5): Gov. Uba Sani's administration completed the ultramodern Kakuri Bus Terminal (Southern Terminal) featuring four commuter terminals, a motel, shops, and a fire station, complementing Millennium City and Rigachikun terminals.

EDO (PSI 8.3): SSG Umar Ikhilor announced Gov. Monday Okpebholo's selection for the Silverbird Man of the Year Award for combating cultism and kidnapping during an Auchi stakeholder engagement, while EDOHERMA issued five regulatory certificates to US diaspora-backed JEMA Hospitals.

CROSS RIVER (PSI 8.1): Cross River highlighted the renovation and reopening of the Calabar International Convention Centre (CICC) to drive global MICE tourism following AfSNET and Bakassi port milestones, while CR-SEMA assessed fire damage at 37 Ebuka Street, Calabar South for victim relief.

ADAMAWA (PSI 7.9): Gov. Ahmadu Fintiri's administration completed the Mararaban Garta to Kamale Road in Michika LGA featuring a four-cell bridge and drainage, while Works Commissioner Mohammed Suleiman inspected runoff flooding at Dougire Primary School in Yola.

IMO (PSI 7.8): Gov. Hope Uzodimma announced the successful lifting of the maiden commercial international flights from the remodeled and upgraded Sam Mbakwe International Cargo Airport (SMICA), Owerri.

ENUGU (PSI 7.6): Gov. Peter Mbah's administration completed a full-scale upgrade of Government Technical College (GTC) Enugu, delivering modern classrooms, workshops, student hostels, and staff quarters alongside its Smart Green Schools rollout.

NASARAWA (PSI 7.4): Nasarawa First Lady Haj. Farida Sule flagged off ₦50,000 cash grants and wrappers for hundreds of women in Agyaga and Nunku wards of Akwanga LGA, while Gov. Abdullahi Sule received incoming Police Commissioner Sheikh Mohammed Danko and commended outgoing AIG Shetima Jauro Mohammed.

FCT ABUJA (PSI 7.2): FCTA clarified that Minister Nyesom Wike's allocation of 4,519.80 hectares to UNIABUJA (down from 11,824.04 hectares) exceeded the 100-hectare NUC benchmark recommended by a 2016 FCTA-UNIABUJA Joint Committee and curbed unauthorized land sales.

ZAMFARA (PSI 7.0): Zamfara Ministry of Information and Culture, supported by UNICEF and traditional rulers, convened a Youth Summit on Behavioural Change mobilizing young leaders across child rights, health, education, nutrition, and WASH.

OSUN (PSI 6.6): Gov. Ademola Adeleke's spokesperson Mallam Olawale Rasheed refuted claims of partisan demotion of monarchs, clarifying that the Ataoja-in-Council disciplined two local Baales over land grabbing and insubordination.
